subject: The year you closed the second warehouse
body:
Riley,

When Stonefield closed its second warehouse in 2025 you wrote that the decision took four minutes and the explanation took four months.

I study computer science and I am building scheduling software for small crews, so I keep thinking about that gap between deciding and explaining.

Would you have fifteen minutes this winter for a few questions about how you told your team?

Matthew McCluster
mattmccluster@gmail.com
